notes: Corrected the article of šənat ha-dərôr → *the year of liberty*. The accepted alignment supplied the *the* to the construct and marked the article on dərôr unrepresented; the phrase writes a single *the* at its left edge with the rectum rendered bare, which is rule 29's fronting case (lūḥōt hā-ʾăbānîm, kûr ha-barzel), so the present article takes it and the construct keeps only *year*. Rule 29 supplies a *the* on a construct only where no article morpheme is present, and marks an article unrepresented only where no *the* is written for the phrase at all.
The two-*the* phrases elsewhere in the chapter (46.2, 46.3, 46.9, 46.19, 46.24) are unaffected: there each article takes the *the* standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
*as for* remains added: the fronted naḥălātô carries no marker and no preposition, so nothing licenses the expression (rule 16's limit, as in wə-marʾêhem → *And as for their appearance*).
